title: HTTP media response
responsibility: Serves media bytes as a full response or a single validated byte range.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.range
inputs.description: Optional Range header, null or empty for a full response.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.disposition
inputs.description: Optional Content-Disposition header, defaulting to inline.

outputs.name: mediaResponse
outputs.description: Response with no-store, nosniff and byte-range support. No range returns all bytes with 200; valid single closed, open-ended or suffix ranges return 206 and matching length/range headers. Malformed or unsatisfiable ranges return 416 with total length.
